_comment: The curated Library entries published as standalone full pages (the public sample). Picked for search intent (what people actually google before touching their PC) with a deliberate verdict mix — the site celebrates REAL wins, not just refusals (doctrine §5). Batch #2 (2026-07-15, web-design-director SHIP-WITH-CHANGES) added the real-win weight so the sample stops reading refusal-heavy; the verdict==='real' picks also surface in the library index's 'Real wins' strip. ~16% of the 191-entry book is public; the rest ships in the app. Cowork/owner swap freely by id; every id must exist in the Library. Re-run `node site/generate.mjs` after changing.
